Then reason: the southern region of Russia is located in the middle latitudes of the Northern Hemisphere, approximately in the area from 40°N to 55°N. Compare this latitude range with the suitable latitude bands of the crops in the figure, and combined with the fact that the question asks about a cash crop, it can be judged that the cash crop with relatively large output in southern Russia is sunflower.

method.method_draft: 先读图：图中横轴是北半球纬度0°—60°N，各条横向阴影带表示不同农作物最适宜生长的纬度范围；其中“向日葵”的适宜纬度带大致位于中纬度约35°N—50°N。再读题：问题问“俄罗斯南部地区”产量较大的经济作物。结合地理位置，俄罗斯南部大致处在北半球中纬度，约40°N—55°N附近。把该纬度范围与图中各作物适宜纬度带对照，且题目限定为经济作物，可判断与俄罗斯南部相符的是向日葵。
